notes.title: Update Version 1.101 7/8/2016
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25317765/5c4cb2dd74e684a8e775a1f8ebbcc012bd570565.jpg[/img]

Add Map System into the game.
-Player can check map by click the Map button(Tab as default for keyboard).
-You can check area zone by look at the Map color.
-For old player who have old save. The program will auto create the map data (Upon boss defeated, Treasure collection).
-You can zoom in/out in the map menu by click an attack button(X as default for keyboard).
-Add map button mapping in the config menu(old config file cannot be use).

Add Full Screen in the Config Menu.(still can switch by click alt+enter).

Add Story Skip mode into the game.
-Can skip a story by click the Shift Button(Shift as default for keyboard).

I hope you will enjoy. ːGirlShyː

Best Regards
